card.name: Digits and separators inside numbers
card.fires_on: Responds to the first digit, decimal point, space or dash piece right before the next number in lab values, confidence intervals and day-count lists. It fires where a number is still unfinished.

modes.label: Decimal point in intervals
modes.description: The decimal point after a leading 1 in hazard ratios and confidence intervals.

modes.label: Space or digit before a value
modes.description: A space or first digit just before a number in thresholds, ranges and dosing intervals.

modes.label: Broken minus sign in day lists
modes.description: A partial dash character inside a day countdown before transplantation.
